title: Explainable SVM predicts chronic postsurgical pain after hip arthroplasty for hip fracture
summary: An SVM, the best of six algorithms with LASSO and Boruta feature selection, integrated clinical, CT-derived gluteal muscle and nutrition-inflammation indices in 881 hip-fracture patients and reached AUC 0.854 on a temporal test set (October 2024 to March 2026; sensitivity 0.789, specificity 0.763, NPV 0.913). GNRI was the top SHAP predictor. The study is single-centre and retrospective with temporal rather than geographic validation.
ai_technology: SVM (best of six algorithms, LASSO and Boruta feature selection) integrating clinical, CT-derived muscle and nutrition-inflammation indices
organization: The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University

evidence.unknown: Multi-center and prospective performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A support vector machine predicted chronic postsurgical pain from clinical, imaging and nutritional features.
